output_policy: Preserve usable current local output when commit is deferred; mark tentative explicitly
reliability: Shared forward-and-reverse reference localization for local and global hypotheses; not an identity probability
reference: Only the initial RGB and supplied initial box; current candidate templates are temporary verifier inputs
competition: Only reference-verified spatial alternatives can block a commit; no raw detector veto
threshold_provenance: All numeric policy values unchanged from V3; the existing verification overlap and response minima are also used for the reverse check
presence_semantics: Unconfirmed localization is not physical absence
